structured_output.analysis:
The best grid, iso_3.15, measured KL 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e] at 3.14795 average bits, against a 3.1484-bit budget. That leaves almost no room, so any upgrade has to be paid for with a downgrade. The single-layer predictions add up to 0.39826, below the measured value, so layer interactions matter.

The loss is concentrated in the MLP projections of blocks 1–3, 14, 18 and 27. The cells on the int3 methods are already on their lower-KL int3 variant:
- 3.up and 1.up use rht_gptq_int3 (0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5] and 0.00611 [E0564bc6ad1eb]), which beats gptq_int3 on both layers.
- 2.up and 27.up use gptq_int3 (0.00642 [E9baa10763ebe] and 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded]), which beats rht_gptq_int3 on both layers.
- 27.gate uses rht_gptq_int3 (0.00499 [Efa0bb391da67]), which beats gptq_int3 (0.00674 [E9eeb9841ba46]).

So swapping methods at the same bit width gains nothing. The real gains need int3→int4 upgrades. For example, 27.gate would drop to 0.00153 on rht_gptq_int4 [Ef428ac081334]. The evidence names no cheap downgrades to fund them.

This round therefore tests settings that should not change stored bits: act_order and damp. It also tests freeing bits by coarser int4 groups to fund one upgrade.

proposals.name: iso_actorder
proposals.rationale: Test act_order=true on every GPTQ-family cell; the stored bits should stay the same. The loss sits in GPTQ int2/int3 MLP cells, e.g. 14.down rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 [E4c3f9b73e065] and 27.up gptq_int3 at 0.00572 [Ef04d8aa7bded]. The base measured 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: iso_damp05
proposals.rationale: Test damp=0.05 against the default damp=0.01; the stored bits should stay the same. The activations feeding the worst layers have heavy outliers, e.g. kurtosis 1090.09 on 27.up [E24beed188b6a], so a larger damp may make the Hessian more robust. The base measured 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: iso_actorder_damp005
proposals.rationale: Test act_order=true together with a smaller damp=0.005; the stored bits should stay the same. This brackets the damp=0.05 test. The top-loss cells are GPTQ int3 MLPs, e.g. 3.up at 0.00642 [E6f4f7ea296d5] and 2.up at 0.00642 [E9baa10763ebe]. The base measured 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].

proposals.name: iso_g256int4_up27gate
proposals.rationale: Set weight.group_size=256 on the int4 cells to cut group metadata bits, and spend the savings upgrading 27.gate from rht_gptq_int3 to rht_gptq_int4. In the single-layer table that upgrade lowers its KL from 0.00499 [Efa0bb391da67] to 0.00153 [Ef428ac081334]. The bf16 alternative costs 12.85 extra bits per weight [E1f08d479a78e]. The base measured 0.43614 [E514ab09c524e].
